name: Happy Summer
source:
This VN game about a 37yo man, who lives in a big house with Rosie "D" and Lucy "S". Rosie is a 19yo beautiful blonde. She tries to write stories and maybe someday she will be able to write a book. Her mother left her 4 years ago and now you need to take care of her as never before. Also, soon Lucy will come to your house and you will have a lot of fun with her and with other characters in the city ;)

[From [url=https://caizergames.itch.io/happy-summer]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这部视觉小说讲述了一名37岁男子的故事，他和Rosie「D」与Lucy「S」住在一栋大房子里。Rosie是位19岁的金发美女，喜欢写故事，也许有一天能写成一本书。四年前，她母亲离开了她，如今你需要比以往更加照顾她。不久Lucy也会搬来，你将和她以及城里的其他角色度过一段愉快时光；）

[来源：[url=https://caizergames.itch.io/happy-summer]Itch.io[/url]]
